name: bolibazzar-admin-web
notes: When you're ready to split off, run: cd apps/admin-web && npm install && npm run dev. Copy AdminDashboard component from ../../app/page.js into ./app/page.js as the root, and copy the /api routes into ./app/api. Configure Vercel env: ADMIN_EMAILS, MONGO_URL, DB_NAME. Deploy on a private subdomain like admin.bolibazzar.in.
